steps.start: the confluence of Murray River and Quality Creek
steps.quote: Commencing at the confluence of Murray River and Quality Creek and proceeding northwesterly in a straight line to the summit of Mt. Bergeron

steps.direction: turning 90° to the southwest and proceeding southwesterly
steps.until: a point on the middle thread of Bullmoose Creek
steps.quote: thence turning 90° to the southwest and proceeding southwesterly in a straight line to a point on the middle thread of Bullmoose Creek
thence proceeding downstream along the middle thread of Bullmoose Creek to its confluence with Wolverine River

steps.until: the southerly bank of Wolverine River
steps.quote: thence southerly to the southerly bank of Wolverine River

steps.until: the westerly bank of Murray River
steps.quote: thence downstream along the southerly bank of Wolverine River to the westerly bank of Murray River

steps.until: a point opposite the southerly bank of Flatbed Creek
steps.quote: thence southerly along the westerly bank of Murray River to a point opposite the southerly bank of Flatbed Creek

steps.until: the southerly bank of Flatbed Creek
steps.quote: thence easterly to the southerly bank of Flatbed Creek
thence upstream along the southerly bank of Flatbed Creek to Highway 52

steps.until: the Tumbler Ridge height of land
steps.quote: thence due North to the Tumbler Ridge height of land

steps.until: a point due East of the southeast corner of Lot 304 Peace River District
steps.quote: thence northwesterly along the top of the ridge to a point due East of the southeast corner of Lot 304 Peace River District

steps.until: the easterly bank of Murray River
steps.quote: thence due West to the easterly bank of Murray River
thence northeasterly along the bank to the point of commencement
